Summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio is to visit the UAE, Kuwait and Bahrain from June 23 to 25, as the Trump administration seeks to build support for its preliminary agreement with Iran. Rubio is expected to discuss with senior leaders the Iran memorandum of understanding, efforts to ensure safe transit through the Strait of Hormuz and wider regional security issues. While in Bahrain, Rubio will also meet representatives of the Gulf Co-operation Council, to discuss shared regional priorities and the next steps following the Iran accord
